claims.claim: Lever trains a verifier on NL input, program, and execution result, then reranks by combining verification score with generation probability and marginalizing over programs with identical execution results.
claims.scope_conditions: four datasets: Spider, WikiTQ, GSM8k, MBPP
claims.quoted_support: The sampled programs are reranked by combining the verification score with the LLM generation probability, and marginalizing over programs with the same execution results.

claims.claim: Lever improves over base code LLMs by 4.6% to 10.9% with code-davinci-002 and sets new state of the art on all four benchmarks.
claims.quoted_support: improves over strong baselines that use execution error pruning by 4.6% to 10.9%

claims.claim: Verification labels are binary by execution match to gold; for multi-test datasets a program is correct only if execution results match on all test cases.
claims.quoted_support: For datasets that provide multiple test cases, we label a program as correct if and only if its execution results match the ground truth program on all test cases.

breadth.confidence_families: Learned verifier probability P(v|x,y,z) over NL, program, execution result, combined with LM generation probability (Section 2-3, Eq. 4 loss). No verbal or hidden-state confidence.
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: Codex code-davinci-002, InCoder-6B, CodeGen-16B-multi generators; T5 and RoBERTa verifier backbones (Section 3 Models).
breadth.post_training_stages: not present (searched: RLHF, SFT of generator; few-shot prompted generators with trained verifier)
breadth.elicitation_formats: Few-shot prompted sampling (greedy vs sampling), execution results as verifier input (Section 2-3).
breadth.label_independence: Verifier trained on training-set samples and evaluated on dev/test splits of each benchmark; ablations (Section 5).
breadth.contamination_split: not present (searched: contamination, release date, temporal split)
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present (searched: ECE, Brier, calibration; evaluation is execution accuracy)
breadth.causal_intervention: Ablation of verifier inputs (NL, program, execution result) and aggregation (Section 5); no model-internal intervention.
